speaker: ceo
text: Town hall announcement: five days a week in the office, effective next month. 'For collaboration.' Someone asks about people who live far away. The CEO smiles warmly: 'Have you considered living closer to the office?' Applause from the leadership row, all of whom have drivers.

choices.label: Check room rentals near the office
choices.result: $3,800 a month for a 'cosy common room'. The photos show a storeroom with a window. The window faces another wall. Commute it is.

choices.label: Post an anonymous Slido question
choices.result: 'Will there be a rent subsidy for moving closer?' 312 upvotes in ninety seconds. The host scrolls past it with the speed of a professional. 'Great questions, everyone!'

choices.label: Build a dashboard of everyone's commute
choices.result: You're the data team, after all. Average commute: 68 minutes each way. 11 hours a week, per person, 'for collaboration'. Gordon sees it: 'NOW this is a bigger problem.' It never leaves his inbox.

choices.label: Laugh along with the leadership row
choices.result: Nobody else is laughing. You're laughing alone, in a hall of 400 people. You stop. You stop very slowly.

speaker: ceo
text: At the town hall Q&A, someone asks about employee morale. The CEO smiles: 'If you're not happy here, the lift goes down as well as up.' Applause from the leadership row only.

choices.label: Laugh nervously with everyone
choices.result: The laugh echoes. Somebody's resignation letter autosaves.

choices.label: Post 'interesting session!' on the internal forum
choices.result: 14 likes. Every single one is a sarcastic like. Everyone knows. Nobody says.

choices.label: Check how fast the lift actually goes down
choices.result: 23 seconds, floor 23 to lobby. You time it. You're not planning anything. Just curious.
